reason: The numbers are fine on paper, but this is a concept for a lodge that does not exist, made by a design studio I have never heard of. I'd have to pay $800 plus a booking engine change and staff time on the strength of a slide about a pretend guesthouse. I'd run the free calculator out of curiosity and close the tab.
objection: Who has actually done this and kept the guests? Slide 3 is labelled 'illustration', so the $650 is a guess, and I have a dozen tools already promising to cut commission.
would_change_my_mind: A named hotel of our size, with real before-and-after figures for direct bookings and commission, that I can phone and check, plus a setup that works with our current booking engine and does not cost us visibility on Booking.com.
